import sys, types
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.feature_selection import VarianceThreshold
from sklearn.utils._set_output import _safe_set_output

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [True, False, True], "b": [1, 2, 3]})

def run(set_output_impl):
    """Monkeypatch ColumnTransformer.set_output with a given impl, in memory only."""
    orig = ColumnTransformer.set_output
    def patched(self, *, transform=None):
        super().set_output(transform=transform)
        transformers = (
            trans
            for _, trans, _ in __import__("itertools").chain(
                self.transformers, getattr(self, "transformers_", [])
            )
            if trans not in {"passthrough", "drop"}
        )
        for trans in transformers:
            _safe_set_output(trans, transform=transform)
        set_output_impl(self, transform)
        return self
    ColumnTransformer.set_output = patched
    try:
        ct = ColumnTransformer(
            [("bool", VarianceThreshold(), lambda X: X.select_dtypes(include="bool"))],
            remainder=VarianceThreshold(),
            verbose_feature_names_out=False,
        ).set_output(transform="pandas")
        return ct.fit_transform(df)
    finally:
        ColumnTransformer.set_output = orig

# OLD behaviour (no remainder handling) -> expect numpy bool/int columns (the bug)
out_old = run(lambda self, t: None)
print("OLD:", type(out_old).__name__)
print(out_old)
print("old dtypes:", list(out_old.dtypes))

# NEW behaviour (the fix) -> expect pandas bool/int columns
def new_impl(self, transform):
    if self.remainder not in {"passthrough", "drop"}:
        _safe_set_output(self.remainder, transform=transform)
out_new = run(new_impl)
print("NEW:", type(out_new).__name__)
print(out_new)
print("new dtypes:", list(out_new.dtypes))

assert isinstance(out_new, pd.DataFrame)
assert list(out_new.dtypes) == [bool, int], out_new.dtypes
assert list(out_old.dtypes) != [bool, int], "old should show the bug"
print("A/B VERIFICATION PASSED: fix changes behaviour as expected")
